text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. In supervised learning, a computer uses training data to learn. This data includes examples with correct answers, so the computer can study them. The computer then builds a model, which is like a set of rules it has learned. Later, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can guess if an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is called accuracy. If the training data is good, the model usually makes better predictions.
